units.source_text: 书仓（Shucang.com），旨在为阅读者弥合数字时代电子化阅读中的各种障碍，

en.t: Shucang (Shucang.com) aims to bridge the various obstacles readers face with electronic reading in the digital age,

units.source_text: 从而让个人获得随时、随地、随意阅读与拥有数字内容的惬意体验。

en.t: thereby allowing individuals to enjoy the pleasant experience of reading and owning digital content anytime, anywhere, and however they wish.
